name: Good Cleanse Face Wash
storage: Store in cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
headline: Farewell grease, hello clear bright skin
description: Embark on a tranquil journey to reveal clean, radiant, supple, and refreshed skin with our essential daily cleanser. This gentle formula banishes excess oil, clears pores, and combats breakouts, without harsh synthetic thickeners. Enriched with the divine aroma of Sandalwood and Saffron, immerse yourself in a magical cleansing ritual!
benefits: Cleanses with soothing aroma of sandalwood & saffron
Controls oil production and clears pores
howToUse: Dampen your skin and apply 2-3 pumps of the cleanser & work up a lather. Gently massage in small circular motions for a minute & rinse off. For best results use twice daily.

description: Unlock radiant skin with our luxuriously foaming face wash! benefits: Smooths fine lines for youthful look

name: Glow Up Pithi Pack
keyIngredients: Home-grown Turmeric, Saffron, Rice Bran Oil, Natural Clays
storage: Store in cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
headline: Timeless formula for radiant soft skin
description: Pithi is traditionally known as a beauty ritual before the wedding that uses the age old potent ingredient, turmeric. We went a step ahead to formulate our signature Sandalwood Saffron Pithi, a blend of super ingredients that brighten, tone & revive the glow skin to your special day. Pithi is age-old wisdom in a tube!
howToUse: After cleansing, apply a thick layer on face & body, avoiding the eye area. Leave on for 20 mins till dry. Rinse clean. Slight tingling sensation is normal as the product repairs your skin. Avoid sun exposure for 2 hours after use. For best results, cleanse, tone, scrub, apply pithi, rinse, moisturize & layer with sunscreen. Use weekly.
